app.title: TokiLink
banner.desc: Web Bluetooth requires Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Opera (Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, ChromeOS). Safari and Firefox are not supported natively.
banner.iosDesc: Safari lacks built-in Web Bluetooth. Choose an option below to connect:
banner.bluefyDesc: Zero extension setup required · Works inside Bluefy browser (bookmarks only)
banner.beacioDesc: Enables Bluetooth in Safari & allows Share → 'Add to Home Screen' as a standalone app.
banner.iosSteps: To install on your Home Screen as an app, use the Safari + Beacio option.
banner.braveDesc: Brave disables Web Bluetooth by default for privacy. Enable it in 3 quick steps:
banner.braveStep2: Set Web Bluetooth API to Enabled
banner.braveStep3: Tap/Click Relaunch at the bottom of Brave
banner.bravePermTip: If already enabled, click the 🔒 icon in the address bar → Site settings → set Bluetooth to 'Ask' or 'Allow'.
banner.permBlockedDesc: Your browser has blocked Bluetooth access for this site. To re-enable:
banner.permStep1: Click the 🔒 lock or 🎛️ tune icon in your browser address bar.
banner.permStep2: Find Bluetooth (or Site settings) and set it to 'Ask' or 'Allow'.
banner.permStep3: Refresh this page to connect to your Seiko clock.
banner.androidPairedDesc: Your phone has paired with this clock in Android Bluetooth settings, locking the connection in the background.
banner.androidPairedStep1: Open your phone's Settings → Bluetooth (or Connected Devices).
banner.androidPairedStep2: Find your clock under Paired Devices and tap ⚙️ → Unpair / Forget.
banner.androidPairedStep3: Return here and tap Sync to connect directly.

settings.useApi.desc: Fetch high-precision NTP time from online time servers
settings.manualOverride.desc: Unlock World Time slider and custom datetime picker to sync alternate timezones or dates
settings.24h.desc: Show time in 24-hour format in app (physical clock 12h/24h display is set by its hardware switch)
settings.debug.desc: Log BLE payload bytes and timing to browser console
settings.forceAllTabs.desc: Display Audio, Radio & Alarm tabs for any connected clock with model compatibility notes
settings.persistentTipDesc: Enable persistent Bluetooth permissions in your browser to remember your clock permanently across reloads for instant 1-click sync.
notice.alarmCompat: Your clock ({name}) is a digital LED/LCD display unit. Alarm sound playback & schedules are supported on Seiko SS501 / SS201 Multi-Sound hardware.
notice.radioCompat: Your clock ({name}) does not have an FM radio tuner or speaker amplifier. Radio controls are supported on Seiko SS501 / SS201 Multi-Sound hardware.
notice.displayCompat: Your clock ({name}) manages display dimmer settings directly on its chassis. Remote brightness commands are tailored for SS501 / SS201 units.
settings.diagnosticTipDesc: Run a deep GATT hardware scan on any Seiko clock to inspect services & characteristics, test compatibility, and export a support package.
diagnostic.title: Hardware Diagnostic & Support
diagnostic.introDesc: Connect and deeply scan your Seiko clock to inspect its hardware GATT services, read descriptors, test protocol compatibility, and generate a support package for the developers.
diagnostic.noticeDesc: Deep scan is generally not needed. It turns off all Bluetooth filters and lists every device in your vicinity (smartphones, TVs, beacons). It may take several seconds for the browser to retrieve names. Use only if your Seiko clock is not found using the default Fast Scan.
diagnostic.deepDiscoveryLabel: Deep Discovery Mode (Scan all nearby Bluetooth devices)
diagnostic.deepDiscoverySub: Disables name filters to discover uncatalogued or custom-renamed Seiko hardware.
